ALPHA GUIDE

What, if any, has been your experience of Christianity? 
• Boring? 
• Untrue? 
• Irrelevant? 
 
I wish that everyone could get rich and famous and have everything they ever dreamed 
of so that they would know that’s not the answer.  Actor/comedian – Jim Carrey 
 
Drugs & Alcohol are not [Problem] Reality is my [Problem]   Drugs and Alcohol are my 
[Solution] to fill up a hole inside me.  Comedian/actor – Russell Brand 
 
At the heart of the Christian faith is the person of Jesus Christ. 
Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life; whoever comes to me will never hunger, and 
whoever believes in me will never thirst. (John 6:35) 
[6:35] “bread of life” is a figure for God’s revelation in Jesus; in Jn 6:51–58, the 
Eucharistic theme comes to the fore. 
 
You can have everything in the world ----- and still be the loneliest man.   And that’s the 
most bitter type of loneliness.   Success has brought me world idolization & millions of 
pounds but it’s prevented me from having the One Thing we all need.  A loving, ongoing 
relationship.   Lead singer of Queen – Freddie Mercury 
 
1. JESUS SAID, “I AM THE WAY AND THE TRUTH AND THE LIFE.”  John 14:6 
Jesus said to him, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except 
through me.  John 14:6 
14:6] The truth: in John, the divinely revealed reality of the Father manifested in the 
person and works of Jesus. The possession of truth confers knowledge and liberation 
from sin (Jn 8:32). 
 
The first-order questions of life: 
• Is there more to life than this? 
• What am I doing on earth? 
• What is the point of life? 
• What is the purpose of my life? 
• Where am I heading? 
 
C. S. Lewis: “I believe in Christianity as I believe that the sun has risen: not only because I 
see it, but because by it I see everything else.”1 
 
Jesus is the lens through which we see God. He is the way to God. Jesus is also the lens
